contract: A23-75 (user 2026-10-08): Config.GamePasses XP2 (2x XP, 199) / Gold2 (2x Gold, 149) / VIP (249), Attr PassXP2 / PassGold2 / PassVIP, Id 0 = not sold (never asked, 'Coming soon'). At join the server asks Roblox (UserOwnsGamePassAsync, 3 tries, waits 1 s then 2 s; every try failing = the last saved answer, data.PassSeen) and PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished (purchased) turns a pass on at once (a late 'no' never takes it back that session). x2 applies once per grant in ProgressionService: every XP grant, and gold from the earned sources (Monster, Quest, Event, Bounty, War, Loot, Kaiju minted part, SignOn, Attendance) - never Sale / Refund / Plunder / KaijuBank / KaijuTransfer / Penalty / Other; GetXPMult / GetGoldMult leave it out; the A23-27 one-level cap holds after it; each grant returns what was added and every line shown uses it. Looks: 4 sold (99) + 6 attendance-only (14 / 50 / 100 days, GrantLook), LooksOwned in shop order, LookOn = an owned look of the player's faction (SetLook, 0.5 s; a faction switch hides it). VIP owners go on the supporter board (GameState SupporterNames, newest first, 30, a shared DataStore list read every 5 min; a hidden name never). Studio DebugCommand Pass / LookGrant are session-only test aids.
limitations: MarketplaceService, DataStores, Players and the PlayerService are doubles; real Roblox answer times, purchase prompts, game pass ids and the shared list across real servers are only checkable after the user creates the passes (Studio / a published test). The grant sites outside ProgressionService are checked as source text (their source and that their line uses the returned amount), not run.
